description: Frontend data bridge: add the four DataContext methods that the pages consume, following the existing *Youtube naming and the useCallback+apiFetch pattern. Depends on FEAT-001 (the endpoints must exist). Small and focused on purpose: it isolates the client/server contract so FEAT-003 (the pages) can be built against stable method signatures.
steps: In frontend/src/contexts/DataContext.tsx, declare in the DataContextType interface (near lines 90-92, beside getYoutubeVideos/searchYoutube/smartSearchYoutube): getYoutubePlaylists: () => Promise<{ playlists: any[] }>; getYoutubeCuration: () => Promise<{ selectedPlaylists: string[]; hiddenVideoIds: string[]; featuredVideoId: string | null }>; saveYoutubeCuration: (cfg: Partial<{ selectedPlaylists: string[]; hiddenVideoIds: string[]; featuredVideoId: string | null }>) => Promise<any>; getYoutubeCuratedSections: (opts?: { includeHidden?: boolean }) => Promise<{ fallback: boolean; sections: any[] }>.

Implement the four methods near lines 543-557 with useCallback+apiFetch: getYoutubePlaylists -> apiFetch('/youtube/playlists'); getYoutubeCuration -> apiFetch('/youtube/curation'); saveYoutubeCuration(cfg) -> apiFetch('/youtube/curation', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(cfg) }); getYoutubeCuratedSections(opts) -> apiFetch(`/youtube/sections${opts?.includeHidden === true ? '?includeHidden=1' : ''}`). Append EXACTLY '?includeHidden=1' (string literal '1' the backend accepts), never includeHidden=true.
Add all four method names to the provider value object (the big return object at line ~789) so they are exposed through useData().
acceptance_criteria: getYoutubePlaylists, getYoutubeCuration, saveYoutubeCuration, getYoutubeCuratedSections are declared in DataContextType, implemented with useCallback+apiFetch, and included in the provider value object.
getYoutubeCuratedSections appends exactly '?includeHidden=1' only when opts.includeHidden === true, and nothing otherwise.
cd frontend && npx tsc -b exits 0 (types line up).
findings:
FEAT-002 implemented in frontend/src/contexts/DataContext.tsx. Added the four DataContext methods consuming the FEAT-001 endpoints, following the existing useCallback+apiFetch *Youtube pattern.

1) Declared in DataContextType (right after smartSearchYoutube):
- getYoutubePlaylists: () => Promise<{ playlists: any[] }>
- getYoutubeCuration: () => Promise<{ selectedPlaylists: string[]; hiddenVideoIds: string[]; featuredVideoId: string | null }>
- saveYoutubeCuration: (cfg: Partial<{ selectedPlaylists: string[]; hiddenVideoIds: string[]; featuredVideoId: string | null }>) => Promise<any>
- getYoutubeCuratedSections: (opts?: { includeHidden?: boolean }) => Promise<{ fallback: boolean; sections: any[] }>

2) Implemented right after smartSearchYoutube with useCallback([]) + apiFetch:
- getYoutubePlaylists -> apiFetch('/youtube/playlists')
- getYoutubeCuration -> apiFetch('/youtube/curation')
- saveYoutubeCuration(cfg) -> apiFetch('/youtube/curation', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(cfg) })
- getYoutubeCuratedSections(opts) -> apiFetch(`/youtube/sections${opts?.includeHidden === true ? '?includeHidden=1' : ''}`). Appends exactly '?includeHidden=1' (string literal '1') only when opts.includeHidden === true; nothing otherwise.

3) Added all four names to the provider value object (after smartSearchYoutube) so they are exposed via useData().

VERIFICATION: cd frontend && npx tsc -b exits 0; npm run build exits 0 (vite build green). No other files touched.

For FEAT-003 (pages): import these via useData(). getYoutubeCuratedSections({ includeHidden: true }) is admin-only server-side (backend honors it only when isAdmin(user)); each section video gains hidden:boolean and likelyShort:boolean when includeHidden. saveYoutubeCuration accepts a partial { selectedPlaylists?, hiddenVideoIds?, featuredVideoId? } and returns the normalized resulting config.
